verses.english: “For insight into greed, ten things should be developed.

verses.pali: Aniccasaññā, anattasaññā, āhāre paṭikūlasaññā, sabbaloke anabhiratasaññā, aṭṭhikasaññā, puḷavakasaññā, vinīlakasaññā, vipubbakasaññā, vicchiddakasaññā, uddhumātakasaññā—
verses.english: The perceptions of impermanence, not-self, repulsiveness of food, dissatisfaction with the whole world, a skeleton, a worm-infested corpse, a livid corpse, a festering corpse,  a split open corpse, and a bloated corpse.

verses.pali: rāgassa, bhikkhave, abhiññāya ime dasa dhammā bhāvetabbā”ti.
verses.english: For insight into greed, these ten things should be developed.”
